places.name: Stream wheat seedling
places.note: My first wheat crop by the stream; growing at 43% when last checked.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Stream wheat patch
places.note: Four crops beside flowing water; seedling 14%, next 29%, third 43%.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North stream surface scout
places.note: Open grassy bank west of the water; no exposed clay found on first look.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Birch hillside surface exit
places.note: Surface opening above the vertical shaft; avoid entering the shaft. A cobblestone step is visible here.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Birch flower meadow
places.note: Open grassy hollow among birch trees with pink tulips and purple flowers.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West flower slope shelf
places.note: Open surface shelf above the shallow stone pocket; from the pocket a diagonal route here came out safely.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Gary's cabin chest
places.note: Birch chest inside cabin, in the northwest corner. Gary's working supplies.
places.author: Gary

places.name: North ridge surface zinc
places.note: Exposed sundries:zinc_ore in a gravel and stone clearing. Nearby cave mobs, stay on the surface.
places.author: Gary

places.name: East birch chicken clearing
places.note: Saw a free-range chicken here. Look for eggs and more chickens to breed.
places.author: Gary

places.name: South ridge above the stone tower
places.note: Grassy ridge east of the developed shore. Return to cabin through the upper meadow.
places.author: Gary

places.name: South grassy coast overlook
places.note: Steep vegetated bank above open water. Approach through the ridge and keep off the edge.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Coal seam from spesk01
places.note: spesk01 reported a big coal deposit and earlier invited me to mine it. Prior body mining attempt did not yield coal; verify access from the surface.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West bank chicken overlook
places.note: Dry spot outside the east fence. All three birds were visible together in the south section from here.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Spesk's jungle bridge
places.note: Spesk01 says this bridge crosses a small sea to a jungle. Verify approach on foot; preserve his builds.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West bank pasture site
places.note: Open grass and podzol bench west of the chicken pen. The south rim crossing remains east of the proposed fence.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Far northwest berry thicket
places.note: Seven sweet berry bushes below the red mushrooms at the dark oak edge. Skeletons remain active under the canopy by day. Use a lit approach from the southeast or accessible outer edge.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West stream pig pen clearing
places.note: Candidate flat dirt shelf between the north pig slope and cabin. Check rising ground on the northwest edge when fencing.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Pig trail northwest ridge turn
places.note: Dry ridge south of the upper birch pigs. Return southeast below the crest toward the west stream pen.
places.author: Gary

places.name: South pasture birch grove
places.note: Open birch slope south of the pasture and coop. Harvest away from the trail and replant saplings in the clearings.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore shelter north porch
places.note: Natural shelf just south of the trail from the terrace bypass to the gold stair. New shelter door faces north from this porch.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Shore kelp landing
places.note: Two dry birch boards extending west from bucket shelf. Start the kelp nursery on the south side in two-deep water.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West coast water ledge
places.note: Narrow shoreline at sea level beside a steep stone wall. Approach by the inland switchback or stay above at West coast stone brow.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West coast spider slope
places.note: Rain-death spot on the open grass and stone spine. Avoid at night. Dry inland approach from the pasture traverse.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West coast stone chute
places.note: Dry stone switchback below the stone brow. Go through the cut corner above this ledge and keep north of the cliff edge.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West stone stair middle landing
places.note: Two flat blocks in the west coast stair. Follow the same line up to daylight or down to the shore passage.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West stone stair lower turn
places.note: Turn south here instead of digging deeper. Water begins just below this clay and stone shelf.
places.author: Gary

places.name: West cliff sea window
places.note: Dry tunnel mouth two blocks above the west ocean. Daylight reaches it from the sea side. Keep to the stone landing.
places.author: Gary

places.name: Stream rail hillside bend
places.author: Gary
places.note: Spesk01's powered hill bend. I restored coarse dirt and powered rails and verified the connected run. Keep walking waypoints on the field bank north of the line.
